title: Aging & Dispute Control | Accounts Receivable | BackOfficeFleet
description: Aging and dispute control for trucking AR teams reviewing invoice aging, customer disputes, missing proof, factoring support, and owner follow-up.
html:
Accounts Receivable / Aging & Dispute Control

Make every open invoice explainable.

Open AR should show amount, age, customer, packet status, dispute category, factoring support, last touch, next touch, and owner.

Accounts ReceivableCustomer Billing

Review logic

Reason codes make follow-up faster.

Missing POD, rate mismatch, detention approval, claim review, customer reference gap, and normal aging each need different action.

Aging buckets

Group open invoices by urgency and reason.

Current, watch, follow-up, disputed, blocked, and escalated buckets help the office act without losing context.

Dispute evidence

Connect the dispute to the packet.

Customer notes, proof documents, rate support, claim evidence, and owner follow-up stay attached to the invoice record.
